name: node
description: Build Node.js backend services that run on VTEX infrastructure. Supports HTTP routes, event handlers, scheduled tasks, and custom API clients via @vtex/api.

requiredFiles.description: Service entry point — exports a Service instance from @vtex/api
Service configuration: routes, events, memory, timeout, replicas
TypeScript config for the node builder

optionalFiles.description: Custom API clients extending ExternalClient or AppClient from @vtex/api
Route and event handler middlewares (async functions)

keyPackages.name: @vtex/api
keyPackages.description: Core SDK: Service class, IOClients, ExternalClient, AppClient, Context type, MasterData, Events

serviceJsonSchema.description: service.json configures routes, events, memory, timeout, and replica settings

fields.workers: Number of worker threads per replica.
fields.routes: Object mapping route names to route config { path, public, policies }
fields.events: Object mapping event names to event config { sender, keys }

contextType.description: The Context object available in every middleware

properties.clients: IOClients instance with all registered clients
properties.vtex: VTEX context: account, workspace, authToken, region, userAgent, requestId
properties.state: State object for passing data between middlewares

import { IOClients } from '@vtex/api'

export class Clients extends IOClients {}
